intent: The US state nearest to Africa is Maine, not Florida, because the Earth is round and the great-circle route to Morocco bends north; the numbers are 5,076 km from Maine versus more than 6,300 km from Florida.
pacing_profile: documentary: cold open, place, why in 2–5 beats, twist, close answers the open, short CTA (docs/STORY_GUIDELINES.md §2)
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses.
title: The US state closest to Africa is not Florida

lines.direction: CRITICAL opener: high-altitude view of the whole North Atlantic, then a hyper-smooth kinetic plunge down onto Florida while the US neon border traces itself; the Florida pin pings on the guess and a red NO stamps it on 'wrong'
lines.text: Which American state is closest to Africa? Almost everyone says Florida. Almost everyone is wrong.

lines.direction: tracking pan north up the US east coast and a dive onto West Quoddy Head (pin + ping); a plane takes off and the camera rides the neon great circle with it across the Atlantic; dive onto El Beddouza (pin + ping); Morocco fills solid
lines.text: The shortest line from the United States to Africa starts up here, at West Quoddy Head in Maine, and lands at El Beddouza in Morocco.

lines.direction: one long pull-out from Morocco to the whole Atlantic with the neon line lit end to end; the counter rolls to 5,076 (the only text on screen); Morocco pulses

dive onto Florida (pin + ping); the dashed neon-blue line draws south-east while the camera tracks it to the Western Sahara coast (pin + ping); the second counter rolls; the Maine line pulses as the winner on 'loses'
lines.text: Now Florida. From its east coast to the nearest African shore is more than 6,300 kilometres. Florida loses by over a thousand.

lines.direction: the plane takes off from Maine again and the camera rides the arcing neon line north-east with it; Morocco pulses on 'bulge'; the camera settles over the whole arc for the card on 'cold'
lines.text: Why? Because the Earth is a ball. The shortest path between two points bends toward the pole, and Africa's bulge leans north too, so the nearest meeting point is up in the cold.

lines.direction: answer the opening line with the same noun
lines.text: Closest to Africa: not the beaches of Florida, but the rocks of Maine.

lines.direction: short follow — the outro visual does the work
lines.text: Follow for a new map story every day.
